name: ARA4101
title: Text exceeds its bounds
summary: Text is wider or taller than its content box or clip at the inspected size and locale.
html:
Text is wider or taller than its content box or clip at the inspected size and locale.

#Common causes

  • Single-line text with a long translation.

#Fixes

  • Allow multiline text, expand the box or scroll; keep the accessible font size.

  • Code: ARA4101

  • Constant: ui::TEXT_OVERFLOW

  • Reported by: ara-ui-test
